unit: one museum catalogue artwork record joined to its digitized image by artwork ID
selection: first 8 CC0 records with web images in the saved 12-record API response; convenience teaching sample
frequency: one API retrieval snapshot; artwork creation dates are not sensor observation times
preprocessing: CLIPProcessor from the same pinned original model revision; RGB web images; eval; L2 normalization; CPU float32
computed_by: instructor demonstration executed with the original public model weights; cached encodings, not live inference in the default notebook
